criteria.text: Identifies that 15% of 16,000,000 Firm Shares is 2,400,000 shares, not the 3,200,000 stated in the Over-allotment Option (Clause 4).
Identifies that the Use of Proceeds allocations sum to $155,000,000, not the stated net proceeds of $150,000,000 (a $5,000,000 overstatement).
Calculates the underwriting commission as $15,400,000 (7.0% of gross proceeds of $220,000,000) and identifies that the stated $17,710,000 is wrong.

Identifies that the $20,000,000 Kingsmere Engineering Ltd class action in the board minutes is omitted from the Prospectus legal proceedings and risk factors, creating disclosure liability, and recommends adding disclosure.
Flags that the Prospectus is inconsistent with the board minutes on legal proceedings.
Shows the over-allotment arithmetic (15% x 16,000,000 = 2,400,000) and flags the discrepancy.
Identifies required third-party, board or regulatory consents/approvals and whether each has been obtained.
